items.detail: The **S&P 500** fell 0.3% to 7,651.54 on Wednesday, while the Nasdaq rose 0.24% to 26,861.06 to end the quarter.
items.why: A softer inflation report gave stocks an early lift, but rising Treasury yields wiped out the S&P's morning gains.

items.detail: Core PCE inflation came in at **3.0%** for August against 3.3% expected, and the odds of an October Fed hike dropped to about 37%.
items.why: It was the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, and the cool reading made another rate hike look less urgent.

items.detail: **Micron** beat forecasts with $54.23 billion in revenue and guided to $61.5 billion next quarter, yet its shares slipped about 1.2% after hours.
items.why: After a huge run-up in memory-chip stocks, strong results were already expected, so the beat did little.

items.detail: Asian stocks outside Japan slipped 0.2% on Thursday and Korea's **Kospi** dipped 0.14%, while China's markets closed for the week-long National Day holiday.
items.why: Micron's record results lifted Samsung and SK Hynix, but a US 10-year yield near 5.3% held back gains.

items.detail: India's **Nifty 50** fell 0.42% to **22,620.45** on Wednesday, though Bank Nifty rose 0.81%.
items.why: Foreign investors sold ₹10,148 crore of shares, taking September outflows to about $2.7 billion.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** fell **0.7%** on Wednesday and trailed the S&P 500 again, even after the softer inflation report.
items.why: Higher Treasury yields raise borrowing costs for small companies, which outweighed the drop in Fed hike odds.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** traded near **$83,500** on Thursday after failing to hold a move above $85,000.
items.why: A 10-year yield at 5.3% outweighed spot ETF inflows, which slowed to $66.2 million on Tuesday.

items.detail: **Ether** traded between about $2,670 and $2,725 on Wednesday, still below its $2,800 ceiling, as leveraged bets fell to their lowest level since March.
items.why: Traders cut leverage while they wait for a clearer signal from yields and Fed policy.

items.detail: **Solana** held near **$119.72** to finish September about 19% higher, its best month of 2026.
items.why: It rebounded from mid-$90s lows earlier in the month, and profit-taking near $125 capped the rally.

items.detail: **Spot gold** jumped to $4,219 on the PCE report, then reversed to end Wednesday down about 0.6% near **$4,157**, leaving gold futures down 6.85% for September.
items.why: Treasury yields rose again in the afternoon, which outweighed the drop in Fed hike odds.

crossCuttingTheme: Cooler inflation cut October hike odds to 37%, but the 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.3%, its highest since 2002, and erased early gains in US stocks, small caps, gold and crypto.
